runtime_prompt_en:
Create a photorealistic mainstream swimwear campaign featuring a clearly adult original K-pop-idol-inspired woman in her mid-twenties with a distinct fictional face. The casting remains an original adult fashion model. She has luminous porcelain-pale skin, long glossy dark hair, and a slender athletic silhouette. She wears a sleek one-piece swimsuit in opaque matte fabric. The swimsuit is deep navy blue with wide straps, a clean neckline, and a full-coverage cut. At a bright ocean waterline, she stands barefoot in a three-quarter front view, her torso angled about 45 degrees toward the camera while her face turns softly toward the lens. Frame her full figure in a balanced vertical composition from a restrained low camera position in front and slightly to one side. Her legs stay gently adducted with the knees close. The actual upper inner-thigh contours form clean opposing boundaries. A narrow background opening of pale beach remains between them, creating anatomical negative space and a readable thigh gap. The appealing focal geometry stays subtle within the full figure. This is true anatomical negative space, not shadow or a wide stance. Keep the leg geometry readable at thumbnail scale. Warm late-afternoon sunlight traces her hair, shoulders, and legs; gentle surf, pale sand, and a clean horizon create polished contemporary K-pop editorial styling. Keep the mood confident and calm.

Avoid: distorted fingers, 3D render look, over-processed retouching, plastic-looking skin, cartoon style, unrealistic hands, illustration look, low resolution
